name: CLTV
summary: BIP-65 introduced OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY (CLTV), a new opcode that allows transaction outputs to be locked until a specific time or block height, enabling time-locked transactions, payment channels, and atomic swaps.
summaryZh: BIP-65 引入了 OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY（CLTV）操作码，允许交易输出锁定到特定时间或区块高度，实现了时间锁交易、支付通道和原子交换。
